approved_append: In this clause, Greek and Syriac read “A wise man is better than a strong one.” This may reflect a different Hebrew reading or interpretation; which Hebrew wording came first remains uncertain. POB provisionally retains the Masoretic text.

decision.strongest_countercase: Parallel superiority of wisdom over strength, shared comparative first clause and strategy context support an economical different Hebrew reading.
decision.limit: Versions do not uniquely restore that Hebrew spelling/vocalization; thematic coherence fits both readings and does not prove priority.
decision.reopen_when: Identified Hebrew witness evidence or discriminating versional/transmission analysis changes the balance.
